statement: For fixed k>ell>=0 and a general-frequency Riesz germ f with sup_(Re(s)>0)|f(s)/(1+s)^ell| finite, the fixed-order Riesz means converge almost everywhere to the horizontal boundary limit. The source separately recalls a classical theorem allowing finitely many boundary poles under a uniform growth condition.

comparison: f(z)=1/zeta(1/2+z) violates the finite-order uniform growth condition near any critical boundary zero; infinitely many boundary poles also violate the classical finite-pole version. Hence neither inspected statement directly supplies the moving weighted-product norm criterion.
